# Fraterworks

> Fraterworks supplies premium raw materials for perfumers, including proprietary fragrance bases, natural absolutes, and aromachemicals inspired by classical formulations.

Fraterworks specializes in recreating and preserving classic perfume bases from the Grasse tradition, offering both floral and animalic foundations for professional perfumers. Their catalog includes IFRA-compliant alternatives to vintage ingredients, enabling modern fragrance creation while honoring historical formulas.

## Key Topics

- Fragrance bases
- Floral notes
- Animalic musks
- Natural absolutes
- Aromachemicals
- IFRA compliance
- Vintage formulas
- Grasse tradition

## Floral Fragrance Bases

- [Floral Collection](https://fraterworks.com/collections/floral-bases): Curated collection of neroli, rose, jasmine, and osmanthus bases for floral perfume creation.
- [Jasmin Imperial](https://fraterworks.com/products/jasmin-imperial): French jasmine absolute replacer from Grasse tradition for authentic floral compositions.
- [Rose Imperiale](https://fraterworks.com/products/rose-imperiale): Restoration of classical French rose de mai fragrance base.
- [Neroli Supreme](https://fraterworks.com/products/neroli-supreme): Blend of aroma chemicals and naturals replacing expensive neroli oil.
- [Gardenia J. Ellis](https://fraterworks.com/products/gardenia-j-ellis-988929): Finest white floral gardenia fragrance base on the market.
- [Osmanthus Flowers](https://fraterworks.com/products/osmanthus-369381): Fragrance base with leather and apricot notes for gourmand perfume compositions.
- [Honeysuckle](https://fraterworks.com/products/honeysuckle-584569): Modern honeysuckle floral base combining natural oils with synthetic aromachemicals.
- [Bouvardia DL](https://fraterworks.com/products/bouvardia): Citrus-floral perfume base with orange flower and jasmine notes.

## Specialty & Classic Bases

- [Eccentrics Collection](https://fraterworks.com/collections/eccentrics-collection): Rare and unusual floral fragrance bases for distinctive perfume creation.
- [Orrisodore™](https://fraterworks.com/products/irisodore-120776): Supreme iris base with orris butter, iris resin, and regal naturals.
- [Fleur De Tabac](https://fraterworks.com/products/fleur-de-tabac): Tobacco flower base created by master perfumer Jean Carles.
- [Prunol SP](https://fraterworks.com/products/prunol-sp): Classical floral-fruity base by De Laire with plummy notes.
- [Persicol](https://fraterworks.com/products/persicol): Classical peach base used in Mitsouko and Nuit de Chine fragrances.

## Animalic Fragrance Bases

- [Animalics Collection](https://fraterworks.com/collections/animalics): Collection of ambergris, musk, and civet fragrance bases for animalic compositions.
- [Absolute Ambergris™](https://fraterworks.com/products/absolute-ambergris): Ambergris reconstruction for vintage formulas and animalic notes.
- [Animusk™ Extra](https://fraterworks.com/products/animusk): Animalic musk base with natural animal musks, IFRA compliant.
- [Animalia™ CMP](https://fraterworks.com/products/animalia-animalis): Restoration of classic Animalis base with natural woods and spices.
- [Nearly Deer™ CMP](https://fraterworks.com/products/nearly-deer): Tonkin deer musk tincture replacement for vintage formulas.
